info.title: FriendsBattery API
info.description: API documentation for the FriendsBattery Inventory and Stock Management application

id.description: User ID in BigInt format converted to string

allowed_radius.description: Max distance from center in meters for attendance

sale_type.description: SCRAP/MECHANIC waive product min price; SCRAP requires scrap_serial

rent_fee.description: Fee taken from deposit; refund = deposit - fee

employee_role_id.description: Optional job title id from GET /api/shops/employee-roles

location_id.description: Required for admin (warehouse or shop). Ignored for seller.

allowed_radius.description: Max check-in distance in meters from center

latitude.description: Geofence center; required together with longitude

longitude.description: Geofence center; required together with latitude

allowed_radius.description: Attendance radius in meters (default 100 when lat/lng set)

actions.description: Only CHECK_IN and CHECK_OUT events, newest first

maintenance.description: When true, clients must show maintenance screen

message.description: Optional message for update or maintenance UI

android_update_url.description: Play Store / APK URL for force-update button

data.description: Serial numbers AVAILABLE for the authenticated user

quantity.description: Units to add; optional when only updating price/flags

location_id.description: Target warehouse/location for new units. Omit for actor location or default WH.

adjustment_quantity.description: Positive to add, negative to remove

Admin only. Uses the seller's users.location_id.

get.description: Admin only. Optional type filter for shops vs warehouses.

post.summary: Create a shop or warehouse location
post.description:
Admin only. Creates an active location used for seller assignment,
employees, and inventory placement. Optional latitude/longitude set the
attendance geofence center (both required together); allowed_radius defaults to 100m.

get.summary: Sellers and employees assigned to this location
get.description:
Admin only. Returns SELLER and EMPLOYEE users with users.location_id
equal to this shop/warehouse.

post.summary: Create an employee at a shop or warehouse
post.description:
**Seller:** employee is always assigned to the seller's `location_id`
(body `location_id` is ignored). Seller must have a location.
**Admin:** body `location_id` is required (WAREHOUSE or SHOP).
New employees are active and verified (can log in immediately).

409.description: user_id, username, or mobile already exists

get.summary: Admin view one employee (profile + check-in/check-out only)
get.description:
Admin only. Returns EMPLOYEE user profile and an `actions` timeline
limited to CHECK_IN and CHECK_OUT (from employee_attendance).
Does not include sales, inventory, or seller data.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max attendance rows to expand into actions

404.description: Employee not found (or user is not EMPLOYEE)

post.summary: Transfer stock serials from admin to seller (Admin only)
post.description:
Moves existing AVAILABLE admin-owned product units to the seller immediately.
Creates shipment record (status ACCEPTED), inventory_transactions (TRANSFERRED),
and returns updated inventory counts.

get.summary: Return logged-in user's inventory
get.description:
Scope by role (unit inventory):
- ADMIN: units owned by admin users
- SELLER: units where owner_id = seller
- EMPLOYEE: units where current_location_id = employee.location_id
Employee with no location_id gets an empty list.
